messages:
sara_finance: Noticed a gap in MRR reporting this morning. Several invoices from Feb show $0 tax in NetSuite but Stripe charged tax. MTD tax total off by ~$18k. https://redwood.internal/billing/reports/1765
devon_eng: Looking at the stripe->netsuite sync logs: webhook invoice.finalized processed, but tax lines were dropped when building netSuitePayload. Code uses `line_items.filter(Boolean)` and tax_line can be null sometimes; seems a null check later strips valid tax objects if one property is undefined.
bruce_billing: Which customers impacted? We need to remediate before month close. Can we run a repair job to import missing tax lines as adjustments?
devon_eng: Quick script to identify candidates: `SELECT ns.invoice_id, s.id as stripe_invoice, json_extract(raw_payload, '$.taxes') as taxes FROM net_suite_invoices ns JOIN stripe_events s ON ns.source_event_id = s.event_id WHERE json_extract(raw_payload, '$.taxes') IS NULL AND s.type = 'invoice.finalized' AND s.created > '2026-02-01';`
ops-bot: deploy: ns-sync-fixer v0.9 rolled out to staging at 2026-02-28T05:40Z
emma_support: I've opened tickets for 8 customers flagged by finance. Added note we'll issue tax-only adjustments if confirmed. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-778
sara_finance: Please prioritize. This affects tax reporting for the quarter. If we issue adjustments, include original tax rate and a reference to original invoice id.
devon_eng: Plan: 1) add defensive parsing in ns-sync to treat missing fields as empty arrays not nulls 2) backfill extractor: read stripe raw events for invoice.finalized and insert missing tax lines into net_suite_invoice_lines with source='tax-backfill' 3) run dry-run and produce list for billing review. I'll open PR now; ETA 3h for hotfix + backfill dry-run.
bruce_billing: Include audit fields so we can trace back to the stripe_event id. Also add a reconciliation flag to avoid duplicate backfills
emma_support: I'll hold off on customer communication until we confirm scope. For the 8 tickets, we can send a "we're investigating" update.
devon_eng: snippet from logs where tax object got dropped: 
```
2026-02-28T05:32:11Z INFO ns-sync: building payload for stripe_invoice in_3Kkl...
2026-02-28T05:32:11Z DEBUG ns-sync: line_items raw: [{"type":"line_item","amount":120000},{"type":"tax","amount":24000, "rate":0.2}, null]
2026-02-28T05:32:11Z WARN ns-sync: filtered line_items -> [{"type":"line_item","amount":120000}]
```
sara_finance: Good catch. Once PR is up, tag me and bruce. We'll need accounting sign-off before posting tax adjustments."
